title: Anti-fighter barrage note: what the hits did
description: Feedback fb_1792391288_b1b8a1e9: a barrage of 1 hit against a fleet without fighters read like a hit on the carrier. The combat overlay's barrage note now says, per side that rolled, what the hits did: destroyed fighters, excess hits with no effect, 'No enemy fighters: the hits have no effect', Argent Raid Formation damage, or no hits. Synthetic fixtures through a mocked server (the client reads barrage_start, barrage_hits and the factions the engine already sends).
